summary: Verified Printful truthful-connection bug fix. Backend + frontend all pass. In not-connected state: badge shows 'Not connected', token input + connect button visible, sync/verify/disconnect buttons correctly hidden. Submitting an invalid token (with 'Bearer ' prefix + double space) returns HTTP 400 with the friendly rejection message ('Printful rejected that token. Create a fresh token at Printful → Settings → Developers → API tokens...'), the token is rolled back so status.configured stays false, the badge stays 'Not connected', and the token input remains available for retry — the exact regression the fix targets. /api/admin/printful/verify with no token returns {ok:false, error:'No token configured.'}. Did NOT test the green-connected happy path (no valid Printful token available, as per request).
critical_code_review_comments: printful.py connect endpoint correctly sanitizes token (strips quotes, 'Bearer ', 'Authorization:' prefix) and rolls back the setting on rejection — good defensive behaviour.

PrintMediaPane.jsx: on successful connect, code optimistically sets health={ok:true} before autoSync — acceptable because loadStatus() + subsequent verify on remount reconciles. Minor: a re-verify after autoSync could catch the (rare) case where connect succeeds but the token is immediately revoked; low priority.
seed_data_creation: None. Test cleared any pre-existing printful_token via /api/admin/printful/disconnect at start of each test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_printful_bugfix_iter12.py covers the connect-rollback + verify + status flow. To test the green 'Connected' path, a real valid Printful private API token with store access is required — not available in this environment. Playwright script (in tool output) covers full UI regression for Print Media pane not-connected + invalid-token flows.
rca_of_the_issue: Original bug: badge derived from `status.configured` which was true whenever ANY token STRING was saved — regardless of whether Printful actually accepted it. The token input was gated on !configured, so an admin with a stale/expired token was locked out of pasting a new one. Fix (verified working): (1) backend connect endpoint now sanitizes the pasted token (strips quotes, 'Bearer ', 'Authorization:') and immediately verifies against Printful /stores; on rejection it rolls back the saved token (empties printful_token setting) and returns a friendly 400 message. (2) frontend now derives display state from a live verify call: healthy = configured && verify.ok, tokenBad = configured && verify.ok===false; token input is shown whenever !healthy (including tokenBad), and the sync card is gated on healthy — so the admin can never be stuck on a green badge with a rejected token, and can always paste a replacement without disconnecting.
